thread:
emma liu: Paging — multiple model warmups failing in us-west GPU pool, causing 5xxs for some customers. Root symptoms: OOM during model init, deserialization errors, and intermittent CUDA compile timeouts. Not sure if paging to the oncall rotation yet.

IncidentBot: SEV2 incident created: model-warmup-flare (4015000123)

raj patel: I'm oncall, taking. Which hosts? Can someone paste logs?

sophia ng: Pushing some snippets — seen on node gpu-07:
```
[2026-03-15T10:12:43Z] ERROR model_init: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
[2026-03-15T10:12:44Z] WARN deser: unexpected EOF while reading layer params
[2026-03-15T10:13:01Z] ERROR compiler: kernel compile timed out after 30s
```

mike orourke: noticing nodemap: nodes gpu-05..gpu-09 had repeated container restarts, kernel OOMs and then node flaps. Could be compile cache thrash + memory fragmentation.

leo price: Customer AcmeCorp reported 500s for inference calls to model:v2 starting ~10:11 UTC. CS ticket #5672. Impact: high for their production usage.

raj patel: Ok, immediate mitigations: 1) throttle warmup concurrency to 1 for us-west pools (prevent stampede) 2) temporarily disable prefetch/warmup for enterprise tenants 3) fallback routing to smaller quantized variant. I'll make those changes now.

sophia ng: Patch to runtime to toggle warmup concurrency via feature-flag:
```
curl -X POST https://console/api/flags -d '{"pool":"us-west-gpu","warmup_concurrency":1}'
```
Applied to us-west; verifying.

deploy-bot: Rollout started: apply-config warmup-concurrency -> us-west-gpu (rollout id r-4015)

sophia ng: After throttle, new warmups are queued instead of all starting. Error rate dropped from ~14% to ~3% in the affected pool.

mike orourke: For nodes that are flapping, we're evicting pods and draining before reimaging. Also increasing compile-cache size on nodes to reduce recompile churn: setting /etc/runtime/compile_cache_size=8GB then restart runtime.

raj patel: I'm configuring fallback routing for AcmeCorp to model:v2-8bit (lower mem). Command:
```
redwoodctl routes set --tenant acmecorp --model redwood/mistral-v2-8bit --route-priority=100
```

leo price: AcmeCorp confirms reduced errors after fallback. They still see some latency spikes but no 5xxs. :relieved:

nadia: Heads-up for postmortem — need to evaluate warmup backpressure, compile cache defaults, and tenant-level warmup opt-outs. Also propose a tenant isolation rule to prevent one huge warmup from affecting others.

IncidentBot: Handoff — paging next oncall @sre-rotation for follow-up doc and postmortem.

raj patel: Leaving a short runbook note in incident doc: root cause likely warmup stampede combined with compile-cache thrash causing memory fragmentation -> OOM during deserialization. Mitigations: throttle, fallback routing, enlarge compile cache, drain flapping nodes.

mike orourke: Marking incident steady state at 10:32 UTC; monitoring for 30m before closing. Will document customer impact and runbook items.

emma liu: Thanks team, great coordination. +1 on postmortem. :thumbsup:
